name: Z Squared Inc. Common Stock
summary: Z Squared Inc. operates as an integrated computing infrastructure company, deploying and managing advanced computing equipment across its facilities in North Carolina, South Carolina, and Iowa. The firm diligently oversees and optimizes its extensive network of specialized hardware. This comprehensive approach incorporates dynamic power management strategies, real-time analytics dashboards for performance monitoring, and an internal program dedicated to repair and lifecycle management. These measures collectively aim to maximize the operational efficiency of their hardware assets and minimize capital expenditure. Established in 2022, Z Squared Inc. has its corporate base in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.
